scope.operation: Prepare one new Toy-owned PostgreSQL 17 cluster under the canonical _toy_pg identity.
explicitlyExcluded: Starting the PostgreSQL LaunchDaemon or any persistent database server
Creating a socket or TCP listener
Applying application migrations or creating pg-boss schema
Changing an existing PostgreSQL cluster, service, Homebrew service, or active path
Installing PostgreSQL or resolving a live executable from the installed-service manifest
Appending or executing any root request
scope.queueConstraint: Do not prepare ROOT-R00403 until ROOT-R00402 reaches terminal state. This artifact appends no request and changes none of ROOT-R00401, ROOT-R00402, or ROOT-R00501.

decision.minimumNativeOperation: Run the pinned PostgreSQL 17.11 initdb once, as _toy_pg, into an absent and empty Toy-only data path. initdb may run its private bootstrap subprocess; the owner must not invoke pg_ctl, a persistent postgres server, launchctl, brew services, or any listener setup.
decision.schema44ProofReuse: Reuse build/evidence/R0.10/unfiltered-queue-verification.json as the existing temporary-fixture pg-boss schema-44 proof; do not rerun it. Its caller scope is an ordinary owned fixture and it does not prove _toy_pg filesystem ownership or native service readiness.

servicePostgres.prerequisite: Verified installed-service manifest and authenticated public owner transport are required.

pinsAndEvidence.numericIdentityRule: Treat 314/314 for _toy_pg and 316/316 for _toy_ops as observations only. Resolve the role through the generated canonical role registry and a verified RoleIdentityBootstrap receipt. The operation must accept no caller-supplied UID, GID, role name, data path, executable path, or initdb arguments.
pinsAndEvidence.versionSource: specs/CONTRACTS.md and specs/ops.md; runtime binary path and bottle digest remain manifest-bound prerequisites and were not inspected in this read-only task.

currentOwnerReview.existingInterface: RoleIdentityBootstrap.run(input, context) in packages/ops/src/identity-bootstrap.ts, exported by packages/ops/src/public.ts and dispatched by the registered bootstrap.identities CLI command.
currentOwnerReview.existingRoutePurpose: Verify the protected role-identity receipt and identity-owned bootstrap directories. The current CLI adapter forwards to RoleIdentityBootstrap; this interface does not initialize PostgreSQL.
currentBootstrapDirectorySet: one state/homes/<service-role> directory for each generated service role
missingFromCurrentOwner: manifest-bound PostgreSQL 17.11 initdb invocation under the verified _toy_pg identity
PostgreSQL cluster preparation receipt and public readback
currentOwnerReview.receiptStatus: The admitted doctor establishes observed identities but leaves identityGateVerified and maintenanceIdentityVerified false. A current successful RoleIdentityBootstrap verify receipt is a required owner-side precondition; this plan does not claim one.

minimumOwnerInterface.placement: One new deep Ops owner interface, PostgresClusterBootstrap.prepare(input, context), exposed through @toy/ops/public and one registered toy CLI command. Do not add a daemon, generic privileged-command runner, shell API, or separate service manager.
resolutionOwnedByModule: Validate Ops production context and effective root caller for apply/verify.
Verify the existing RoleIdentityBootstrap receipt and resolve _toy_pg from generated contracts; bind observed UID/GID from that receipt.
Resolve the exact PostgreSQL 17.11 initdb executable and digest from a verified installed-service/runtime manifest.
Use only the canonical data path in the specification; reject symlinked parents, path replacement, nonempty targets, version mismatch, manifest mismatch, or changed preflight digest.

fixedInitdbBehavior.runAs: Verified _toy_pg UID/GID from the identity receipt

minimumOwnerInterface.result: A content-free prepared/verified receipt binding request ID, role identity receipt digest, PostgreSQL executable digest/version, canonical data path, observed owner/mode, PG_VERSION, checksum setting, and effectState. Do not emit user data, database contents, or secret values.
minimumOwnerInterface.deletionTest: If this owner is deleted, the CLI or root caller must resolve protected paths and role identity, select a pinned executable, enforce empty-target/no-symlink and snapshot guards, drop privileges, run initdb with fixed flags, and verify/persist a receipt. That moves privileged policy and failure reconciliation into callers, so this single-operation owner earns its place.

rootCommandPreparation.registrationRequirement: These are the exact proposed argv shapes for the one new registered CLI route; they are not currently executable. Add the command through the repository CLI/contracts paved path and FEATURE-MAP before any root request is prepared. The current registered bootstrap.identities route is a prerequisite receipt verifier, not a substitute PG initializer.
applyPreconditions: ROOT-R00402 is terminal and the parent authorizes a new request
verified installed-service manifest binds PostgreSQL 17.11 executable path and digest
target and every parent pass lstat/ownership/mode checks; target is absent or safely empty under the owner contract
neverDo: Never accept UID/GID/path/binary/options from CLI input.
Never remove, rename, chown, overwrite, or reinitialize an existing cluster.
Never call launchctl, pg_ctl, brew services, or a long-running postgres process.
Never change the installed-service manifest, active pointer, old service, or canonical active path.

targetPathsAndSpecBindings.ownerAndMode: root:root, 0711 per current identity bootstrap owner
targetPathsAndSpecBindings.binding: specs/ops.md TOY_ROOT; control/bootstrap/main.ts current root boundary

targetPathsAndSpecBindings.ownerAndMode: _toy_pg UID/GID from verified receipt; private cluster directory, 0700
targetPathsAndSpecBindings.binding: specs/ops.md PostgreSQL installation section; specs/authority.md _toy_pg identity

targetPathsAndSpecBindings.ownerAndMode: Future socket directory; socket-only, port 5432, socket mode 0770 per specs/ops.md
targetPathsAndSpecBindings.binding: Create only in a later service-install/start card; not created by this preparation.
specs/ops.md canonical process/UID/runtime manifest and specs/authority.md service topology; not installed or activated here.

publicVerification.ownerReadback: The registered prepare --verify mode must independently read the receipt and cluster metadata, verify executable version 17.11, PG_VERSION 17, checksums, _toy_pg ownership, private mode, canonical path, and unchanged service/active-path fields.
publicVerification.externalReadback: After preparation, toy doctor --deep --json may be retained as public evidence, but its current service.postgres NOT_IMPLEMENTED result remains expected until the installed-service manifest and authenticated owner transport exist. Do not claim PostgreSQL readiness from initdb success.
publicVerification.evidence: Persist plan/apply/verify JSON under build/evidence/R0.04 only after a separately authorized implementation and root request; this planning artifact is the only write in this task.

acceptanceBindings.binding: The root-only preparation CLI must remain unreachable from model-controlled terminal/plugin/browser/GUI paths and accept only its fixed registered operation; no sudo capability or arbitrary privileged command is added. This AT protects the invocation boundary, not cluster initialization itself.

Keep preparation as a registered maintenance CLI command, not an MCP tool declared read-only. If a future MCP surface is proposed, its contract must be registered and Authority must block an unregistered read-only claim.

actualDependencyRisks: The saved doctor says the PostgreSQL service owner transport and verified installed-service manifest are not implemented, so the 17.11 executable path/digest cannot be bound from allowed evidence and apply is not ready.
The saved doctor leaves identity and maintenance enforcement gates false; observed UID/GID alone do not prove protected path enforcement or establish a verified role receipt.
The required en_US.UTF-8 locale and exact 17.11 native artifact must be verified by the future owner; absent prerequisites must block rather than fall back or install implicitly.
initdb can leave a partial target after interruption. The owner must record uncertain effects, never delete or overwrite the path, and require explicit read-only reconciliation before retry.
The existing pg-boss schema-44 proof is a temporary fixture and does not prove native service identity, cluster ownership, or daemon readiness. Reuse it without rerunning.
builderOwnedNextAction: Register and specify the single PostgresClusterBootstrap.prepare owner plus CLI/feature-map contract, with the identity receipt, manifest binding, path guards, fixed initdb flags, and receipt verification above. Keep the new root request unsubmitted until ROOT-R00402 is terminal. The separate Toy data path means this work need not alter the old PostgreSQL service or any active path.
